name.en: Monthly payroll with PF and ESI returns
name.hi: पीएफ एवं ईएसआई विवरणी सहित मासिक वेतन

description: Monthly: inputs and the wage register frozen, PF (12 % on wages up to the ceiling) and ESI (0.75 % / 3.25 % for employees within the wage limit) computed per employee by rule, maker-checker approval, wages paid by the 7th (Code on Wages s.17), PF ECR and ESI contributions filed and paid by the 15th, payslips issued.

placeholders.rule: UNVERIFIED (use SYNTHETIC_DEMO_ONLY) PF wage ceiling (Rs 15,000, Rs 25,000 from 17 September 2026), ESI coverage limit (Rs 21,000), ESI continuation to the end of the contribution period and the ESI low-wage exemption (Rs 176 a day), applied per employee by wage period
placeholders.reason: the PF ceiling texts were not read; the ESI limit, continuation, contribution periods and low-wage exemption are not found in current official text after 2026-05-08 (decision 298); the treatment of a wage period crossing a contribution-period boundary has no source (decision 271); deploy the confirmed rules as a tenant override (decision 223)

decisions 288 and 294: EPF Scheme 2026 para 18(5) was read and matches, but its date of publication (Gazette 29 June 2026 or e-Gazette 1 July 2026) is not confirmed, and the 1952 Scheme provision was not read; deploy the confirmed policy as a tenant override (decision 139); applied per employee per wage period to each share (decision 223, payroll.py op EACH)

placeholders.rule: ESI employee rounding is VERIFIED but SYNTHETIC_DEMO_ONLY: next higher rupee from 8 May 2026
placeholders.reason: decision 296: rule 19(1)(b) was read and matches; its use stays SYNTHETIC_DEMO_ONLY because the ESI ceiling, continuation, contribution periods and low-wage exemption were not found in current official text (decision 298); wage periods before 8 May 2026 are refused; deploy the confirmed policy as a tenant override (decision 139); applied per employee per wage period to each share (decision 223, payroll.py op EACH)

placeholders.rule: ESI employer rounding is VERIFIED but SYNTHETIC_DEMO_ONLY: next higher rupee from 8 May 2026
